test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the word which means the same as the group of words given.**

Be harmonious or consistent with
solution: The correct answer is '**Accord**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Accord**'. • **Accord**: to match; to agree with. (किसी के साथ मेल खाना; संगति में होना; सहमत होना) • *Example: I am in **accord** with your plan.* **Correct Answer:__** *Accord.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Discord**: disagreement or argument. (असहमति, अवज्ञा या विवाद, झगड़ा) • **Record**: a written account of what has happened, been done, etc. (घटित घटनाओं और किए गए कामों का लिपिबद्घ विवरण; अभिलेख, रिकॉर्ड) • **Cordon**: a line or ring of police or soldiers that prevents people from entering an area. (पुलिस या सेना द्वारा सुरक्षा के लिए डाला गया घेरा) 3f:Tafe, The correct answer is '**Inadequate**'.
